passages.locator: Paragraph on Andean weaving after the plain-weave description
passages.quote: Around 1400 BCE, the development of heddle weaving allowed several warp thread systems to be used simultaneously, an important technological advance that streamlined the weaving process enormously and spurred the growth of the textile industry in the Andes.

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
